The device features a glossy black front face with the silver Apple logo centered in the upper half. The lower portion shows the faint outline of the click wheel interface, though it is obscured by strong glare and reflections. The casing appears to be plastic or coated metal with rounded corners. The background consists of out-of-focus metallic bars.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the black surface. Real glossy plastics/metal have complex, distorted reflections of the environment. AI often generates 'muddy' or overly smooth gradients instead of distinct reflected shapes. Also, verify if the click wheel buttons are symmetrically placed; AI often distorts the circular geometry.
